第4章超自然
王煊心灵安静，意念集中，正处在入静中，但还是敏锐地感应到有目光落在自己的身上。
他睁开眼睛，注视林外。
四位来自新星的同学惊异，相距还很远，王煊竟有所觉，感知到有外人到来？
“你们看到没有？在他睁眼的刹那，眼中有点点金霞消散。”四人中的周坤低声说道。
王煊停了下来，采气、内养结束，他脸色红润，精神奕奕，在朝霞中，连发丝似乎都晶莹发光。
四人快步走来。
苏婵性子活泼跳脱，隔着很远就打招呼：“王煊，我刚才好像看到你在发光！”
她身材高挑，一点也不怕冷，穿着微露肩的短裙，让长袜下一双美腿愈发显得又直又长，漆黑光亮的长发自然搭在肩头，青春靓丽的面孔上挂着微笑，眼睛漂亮而有神。
王煊笑了：“我能理解为，你这是在夸我英俊，帅气，阳光灿烂吗？”
他身形挺拔，沐浴朝霞，笑起来确实有些晃人眼，炯炯有神的双目，洁白的牙齿，整个人十分灿烂。
“自恋！”苏婵撇嘴。
周坤忍不住问道：“王煊，你练成采气术了？”
他面孔白皙，眉清目秀，只是整个人略带忧郁的气质，其实体质很好，但却总给人缺少锻炼的感觉。
几人来自新星，同窗数年，他们与王煊也算很熟了。
王煊点头：“近期勉强算是练成了。”
四人中的徐文博平日比较高冷，很少与旧土的同学打交道，现在却忍不住开口，带着惋惜之色。
“旧术，从开始出现到现在，真的很久远了，当下有些落伍了。”他摇了摇头。
清晨阳光充足，但秋风吹来，落叶扬起，依旧有些凉意。
李清竹人如其名，柔和文静，带着书卷气，温和地开口：“话不能这么说，旧术最起码可以强身健体，延年益寿，而且据传古代有些人可能很厉害。”

来自新星的几人都知道，这条路已经走不通，现如今被撇弃了，她只是在安慰王煊而已。
王煊心中虽然有些触动，但却不后悔选择这条路，最初，他是因为兴趣去研究旧术，并非抱着功利性目的。
况且，他原本的自动化专业也未放下，早已顺利拿到学位。
徐文博摇了摇头：“那些都是没有根据的传说，况且，生在这个时代，科技极尽绚烂，纵然古代确实有较为厉害的人，可如果复生到现代来，面对飞船、机械兵种等，也都显得毫无意义。”
但他望向远方时，眼中却很热切，像是有火光在跳动，因为他知道，新星那边有了更为震撼人心的发现，那是更好的选择，让他暗自激动，内心异常热烈！
几人又聊了一会儿，苏婵笑着对王煊说，对旧术不要过于投入，毕竟都已经毕业了，该想一想工作方面的问题了。
来自新星的几人知道，当选择错误的路后，再怎样努力都无用。
周坤张了张嘴，想要说什么，但最后却只能无奈地拍了拍王煊的肩头。
碍于家里长辈的告诫，在新星那边的情况没有明了前，他不能泄露任何消息，现在还属于严格保密阶段。
“我祝你们返回新星路途顺利，保重！”王煊点头，他知道，如果没有意外，以后彼此很难再有交集。
新星的大门对旧土早已关闭，如果不是被那边主动选中，这边的人很难移民过去。
“在走之前有机会的话我请你们喝酒。”王煊笑着说道。
四人本已转身离去，但周坤还是一个踉跄，他知道王煊是在笑他呢。
他平日略带忧郁气质，话不多，可一旦醉酒就会彻底放飞自我，口若悬河，说个没完没了。
三年前，就是王煊与秦诚同他拼酒，让他醉的一塌糊涂，自己都不知道那一晚说了什么。
王煊注视他们远去。
在接下来的几天，陆续有同学远行，将回故里。
迫不得已被分隔在星空两端的人，彼此间最为伤感。
班中那对恋人沉默着告别，直到一方登上列车远去，另一方才痛哭出声，让人唏嘘，他们的感情一直很好，最终却这样落幕。
在这个深秋，离去的人无疑是失意的。

虽然新星那边传来的消息很模糊，但许多人已经预感到，与新星擦肩而过，将错过此生最大的机遇。
唯一让离开的人稍感安慰的是，工作问题已经解决，这是早先加入实验班时被承诺的。
王煊还没有离去，因为他的家就在相邻的小城，很近，如果不能前往新星，他将留在上学的这座城市工作。
秦诚已经消失几天，他是本城人，最近一直在打探确切的消息。
他家里做的生意与深空贸易有关，当然只是下面众多供应商之一，但也颇有些门路。
数日后的清晨，秦诚出现在校区。
“王煊，我终于明白当初为何成立旧术实验班，与新星那边发现的特殊‘状况’有关！”
一大清早秦诚就跑来，脸色发红发烫，但并没有气喘吁吁，完全是激动所致。
他家里路子比较广，刚得到一则消息，新星那边发现的几起神秘现象疑似与超自然力量有关！
“世间或许存在超自然力量！”他大声喊道。
这怎能不让人心潮起伏，产生诸多联想？！
秦诚平日是个感性的人，现在情绪波动有些大，但当看清王煊的状况后，他立时有些发呆。
“你竟练出这么大的‘动静’？！”
虽然已经知道王煊采气成功，但看到前方的景象，他还是颇为吃惊。
太阳初升，万物蕴生机，王煊似乎在发光，身上的朝霞格外的“浓郁”，犹若一层淡淡的光焰在流动。
王煊停了下来，精力旺盛，状态比前几日更好。
“你稍等。”
他刚才迎着朝霞，内养己身，排身体中的“浊雾”，导致身上黏糊糊，他快速去冲了个冷水澡。
王煊换上洁净的衣服走出来，道：“我早就有些联想，部分背景很深的老人，到了晚年后越发相信神秘学，最后更是付诸行动，来旧土挖掘神话，投资旧术研究这样的项目，当初肯定是发现了什么。”
那些人虽然老去了，但都曾经是人精，不至于昏聩到犯低级错误。

再有，一些身份与背景不简单的学生，从新星赶来并加入实验班，也佐证了一些事。
“早期，他们或许是想通过研究旧术来触及超自然力量。”王煊说道，但又蹙眉：“但是，现在情况似乎有变。”
他的直觉很敏锐，数天前见到徐文博、苏婵、周坤、李清竹，通过他们的言行，已经猜到部分真相。
几人说过，旧术过时了，落伍了。新星那边……似乎看不上了！
而且，当时徐文博不经意看向天际尽头时，眼中光芒很盛，那是一种憧憬与激动，像是在热切的渴望着什么。
“超自然力量……或许另有一条路，而旧术被抛弃了。”这是王煊观察几人的表现后得出的结论。
晚上还有更新。

content_en:
Chapter 4 Supernatural
Wang Xuan's mind was quiet and his thoughts were concentrated. He was in silence, but he was still keenly aware of eyes falling on him.
He opened his eyes and stared outside the forest.
The four classmates from Xinxing were surprised. They were still far away from each other. Wang Xuan actually felt something and sensed the arrival of an outsider?
"Did you see it? The moment he opened his eyes, a little bit of golden clouds dissipated in his eyes." Zhou Kun among the four said in a low voice.
Wang Xuan stopped and finished collecting Qi and internal nourishment. His face was rosy and he was full of energy. Even his hair seemed to be shining brightly in the morning glow.
The four of them walked over quickly.
Su Chan was lively and outgoing, and greeted her from a distance: "Wang Xuan, I seemed to see you glowing just now!"
She is tall and not afraid of the cold at all. She wears a slightly off-shoulder short skirt, which makes her beautiful legs under her stockings appear straighter and longer. Her long, dark and shiny hair naturally hangs on her shoulders. She has a smile on her young and beautiful face, and her eyes are beautiful and energetic.
Wang Xuan smiled: "I can understand that you are praising me for being handsome, handsome and sunny?"
He was tall and tall, bathed in the morning glow, and his smile was indeed a bit dazzling. His piercing eyes and white teeth made his whole person very brilliant.
"Narcissistic!" Su Chan pouted.
Zhou Kun couldn't help but ask: "Wang Xuan, have you mastered the Qi Collection Technique?"
He has a fair face and pretty features, but he has a slightly melancholy temperament. He is actually very good-looking, but he always gives people the impression that he lacks exercise.
Several of them were from Xinxing and had been classmates for several years, so they were quite familiar with Wang Xuan.
Wang Xuan nodded: "I have barely mastered it recently."
Xu Wenbo, one of the four, is usually aloof and rarely interacts with his old classmates, but now he couldn't help but speak with a look of regret.
"The old technique has really been a long time since it first appeared. It is a bit outdated now." He shook his head.
There was plenty of sunshine in the morning, but the autumn wind blew and the fallen leaves were lifted, making it still a bit cool.
Li Qingzhu lives up to his name, he is gentle and quiet, with a bookish air, and he speaks gently: "You can't say that, the old skills can at least strengthen the body and prolong life, and it is said that some people in ancient times may be very powerful."
Everyone from Xinxing knew that this road was deadlocked and was now abandoned. She was just comforting Wang Xuan.
Although Wang Xuan was a little touched, he did not regret choosing this path. Initially, he studied old techniques out of interest, not for utilitarian purposes.
Moreover, he has not given up his original automation major and has successfully obtained his degree.
Xu Wenbo shook his head: "Those are all unfounded legends. Besides, living in this era, technology is extremely splendid. Even if there are indeed more powerful people in ancient times, if they are reborn in the modern era, facing spaceships, mechanical arms, etc., it will be meaningless."
But when he looked into the distance, his eyes were very eager, as if fire was beating, because he knew that Xinxing had made a more shocking discovery, and that was a better choice, which made him secretly excited, and his heart was extremely warm!
The few of them chatted for a while, and Su Chan smiled and said to Wang Xuan, don't be too devoted to old skills. After all, they have graduated and it's time to think about work issues.
Several people from Xinxing know that no matter how hard they try, it will be useless when they choose the wrong path.
Zhou Kun opened his mouth and wanted to say something, but in the end he could only helplessly pat Wang Xuan on the shoulder.
Due to the warnings of his family elders, he cannot leak any information until the situation on Xinxing's side is clear. It is still strictly confidential.
"I wish you a smooth journey back to Xinxing. Take care!" Wang Xuan nodded. He knew that if there were no accidents, it would be difficult for them to interact with each other again in the future.
The door of Xinxing has long been closed to the old land. If they are not actively selected there, it will be difficult for people here to immigrate there.
"If I have a chance before I leave, I'll treat you to a drink." Wang Xuan said with a smile.The four of them had already turned around and left, but Zhou Kun still staggered. He knew that Wang Xuan was laughing at him.
He usually has a melancholic temperament and doesn't talk much, but when he's drunk, he will completely let himself go, talk eloquently, and talk endlessly.
Three years ago, it was Wang Xuan and Qin Cheng who drank with him and made him so drunk that he didn't even know what he said that night.
Wang Xuan watched them go away.
In the next few days, one after another students will travel far and return to their hometowns.
People who are forced to be separated at opposite ends of the starry sky are the saddest to each other.
The lovers in the class bid farewell in silence until one party boarded the train and left, and the other burst into tears. It was disappointing. Their relationship had always been very good, but it finally ended like this.
In this late autumn, those who leave are undoubtedly disappointed.
Although the news from Xinxing was vague, many people had already felt that if they missed Xinxing, they would miss the biggest opportunity in their lives.
The only thing that gives those who left some comfort is that the work problem has been solved, which was promised when they joined the experimental class earlier.
Wang Xuan has not left yet, because his home is in a neighboring town, very close. If he cannot go to Xinxing, he will stay in the city where he goes to school to work.
Qin Cheng has disappeared for a few days. He is from this city and has been trying to find out the exact information recently.
His family's business is related to deep space trade. Of course, he is only one of the many suppliers below, but he also has some connections.
A few days later, Qin Cheng appeared on campus early in the morning.
"Wang Xuan, I finally understand why the old technique experimental class was established in the first place. It has to do with the special 'situation' discovered by Xinxing!"
Qin Cheng came running over early in the morning, his face red and hot, but not out of breath, it was entirely due to excitement.
His family has a relatively wide network, and he just received news that several mysterious phenomena discovered in Xinxing are suspected to be related to supernatural forces!
"There may be supernatural forces in the world!" he shouted.
How can this not make people's hearts flutter and generate many associations? !
Qin Cheng is usually an emotional person, and his mood swings are a bit big now, but when he saw Wang Xuan's condition clearly, he was immediately in a daze.
"You actually managed to make such a big 'movement'?!"
Although he already knew that Wang Xuan had successfully collected energy, he was still quite surprised when he saw the scene in front of him.
The sun is rising, everything is full of vitality, Wang Xuan seems to be shining, the morning glow on his body is particularly "rich", like a layer of light flame flowing.
Wang Xuan stopped, full of energy and in better condition than the previous few days.
"Just a moment."
He had just faced the morning glow to nourish his body and expel the "turbid fog" in his body, which made his body sticky. He quickly took a cold shower.
Wang Xuan put on clean clothes and walked out, saying: "I have long imagined that some old people with deep backgrounds believe in mysticism more and more in their later years. In the end, they took action and came to the old land to dig up myths and invest in projects such as old techniques. They must have discovered something at the beginning."
Although those people are old, they were once human beings, and they are not so stupid that they make stupid mistakes.
Furthermore, some students with unusual identities and backgrounds came from Xinxing and joined the experimental class, which also proved something.
"In the early days, they may have wanted to access supernatural powers by studying old techniques." Wang Xuan said, but frowned: "But, the situation seems to have changed now."
His intuition is very keen. He met Xu Wenbo, Su Chan, Zhou Kun, and Li Qingzhu a few days ago, and through their words and deeds, he had already guessed part of the truth.
Several people have said that the old techniques are outdated and outdated. Xinxing's side... seems to be dissatisfied!
Moreover, when Xu Wenbo inadvertently looked toward the end of the sky, his eyes were filled with light. It was a kind of longing and excitement, as if he was eagerly longing for something.
"Supernatural power...may have another way, and the old techniques have been abandoned." This is the conclusion Wang Xuan came to after observing the performance of several people.
